This project uses the following third-party software:

1. PDFPLUMBER
   - License: MIT
   - URL: https://github.com/jsvine/pdfplumber
   - Description: Python library for extracting text and table structures from PDF documents
   - Usage: PDF parsing for PROJEF Web e TCU reports

2. PLAYWRIGHT
   - License: Apache License 2.0
   - URL: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-python
   - Description: Browser automation library for web testing and automation
   - Usage: Automation of ProjefWeb and TCU website interactions
   - Note: Optional dependency - imported with error handling if unavailable

3. REQUESTS
   - License: Apache License 2.0
   - URL: https://requests.readthedocs.io/
   - Description: Python HTTP library
   - Usage: API communication for fetching Selic historical data
